svg.text: All printed labels retained; unused pads left unwired.
Pin 1 at top / pin 8 at bottom
v0.1 / UNIFIED ELECTRICAL SCHEMATIC / external board pins only
Continuous wires connect every fitted terminal. Dots = junctions; arched crossings = no connection. Component placement is schematic.
DFRobot and display pins keep physical order. DFRobot: P2 left, P1 right, USB-C up. Outlines and distances are schematic.
Pot: outer legs RING / SLEEVE; wiper TIP.
Variable resistor: TIP to SLEEVE; RING unused.
0-10k per input. Bias HIGH in resistor mode;
high impedance in pot / disabled / boot states.
SW11 contact pin arrangement is functional.
U1 printed MO / MI mean MOSI / MISO.
USB-only supply does not power the external LED rail.
Lens left, leads right, flat side down.
Top to bottom: DIN / 5V / GND / DOUT.
Only LEDs and wires; direct GPIO16 data.
Check 3.3V data acceptance on the actual LED batch.
Netlist, BOM and pin references: design/electrical/. All 44 components and 39 nets are checked against the connected wire drawing.
